[38;5;239m[48;5;237m❯ [38;5;231mCall the AskUserQuestion tool right now — do nothing else [39m
  [38;5;231mfirst. One question: "Which approach should we take for the [39m
  [38;5;231mmigration?" with exactly 3 options: "Incremental refactor", [39m
  [38;5;231m"Full rewrite", "Leave it as-is". Give each a 2-to-3 sentence[39m
  [38;5;231mdescription of the tradeoffs so they wrap across multiple [39m
  [38;5;231mlines. header "Approach".[39m
[38;5;246m[49m────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[38;5;16m[48;5;153m ☐ Approach [39m[49m

[1m[38;5;231mWhich approach should we take for the migration?[0m

[38;5;153m❯[39m [38;5;246m1.[39m [38;5;153mIncremental refactor[39m
     [38;5;246mMigrate piece by piece while the current system keeps [39m
     [38;5;246mrunning, so risk stays low and each step is individually [39m
     [38;5;246mtestable and revertible. It takes longer overall and you [39m
     [38;5;246mcarry the burden of maintaining compatibility shims between
[39m     [38;5;246mold and new during the transition. Best when uptime [39m
     [38;5;246mmatters and the existing system still mostly works.[39m
  [38;5;246m2.[39m Full rewrite
     [38;5;246mRebuild on the target architecture from scratch, free of [39m
     [38;5;246mlegacy constraints and accumulated workarounds. It is the [39m
     [38;5;246mhighest-risk path: a long window with no shippable [39m
     [38;5;246mimprovements, and hidden behaviors in the old system are [39m
     [38;5;246measy to lose. Pays off mainly when the current design is [39m
     [38;5;246mfundamentally at odds with where you need to go.[39m
  [38;5;246m3.[39m Leave it as-is
     [38;5;246mDefer the migration entirely and spend the effort [39m
     [38;5;246melsewhere, accepting the current system's known [39m
     [38;5;246mlimitations. Zero migration risk and zero cost now, but the
[39m     [38;5;246mtechnical debt keeps compounding and a future migration [39m
     [38;5;246monly gets harder. Reasonable if the pain today is low and [39m
     [38;5;246mpriorities are pressing elsewhere.[39m
  [38;5;246m4. Type something.[39m
[38;5;246m────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[39m  5. Chat about this
